name: capture
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; set +e; DUMP_DIR=/tmp/mldr-incl-capture DUMP_MIN=0 DUMP_N=100000 DUMP_ALL=1 GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 60 bun --preload ./research/query/dump.ts --preload ./research/track-p/capture.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken > /tmp/mldr-incl-result.jsonl 2>/tmp/mldr-incl-trace; s=$?; cat /tmp/mldr-incl-result.jsonl; tail -c 5000 /tmp/mldr-incl-trace; echo CAPTURE_EXIT=$s; bun research/mldr-incl/pack-capture.ts /tmp/mldr-incl-capture
